title: Offline RL Without Off-Policy Evaluation

methods.one_paragraph_description: Fit behavior policy beta-hat by imitation and Q^beta by fitted Q evaluation (SARSA-style, on-policy w.r.t. data). Policy draws M samples from beta-hat at each state and executes the one with highest Q^beta; no policy network trained. Single improvement step (K=1).
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL, one-step policy improvement from the behavior Q-function ('one step of policy improvement is sufficient to beat state of the art results on much of the D4RL benchmark')

network.value: MLP, 2 hidden layers of width 1024, ReLU (Q and policy)
network.quote: All of our Q functions and policies are simple MLPs with ReLU activations and 2 hidden layers of width 1024.

policy_distribution.quote: Our policies output a truncated normal distribution with diagonal covariance

behavior_training_steps.quote: we train our β̂ behavior estimate by imitation learning for 500k gradient steps using Adam [Kingma and Ba, 2014] with learning rate 1e-4 and batch size 512.

q_training_steps.quote: We train our Q b β estimator by fitted Q evaluation with a target network for 2 million gradient steps using Adam with learning rate 1e-4 and batch size 512.

policy_training_steps.quote: All policies are trained for 100k steps again with Adam using learning rate 1e-4 and batch size 512.

optimizer.quote: using Adam [Kingma and Ba, 2014] with learning rate 1e-4 and batch size 512

learning_rate.quote: using Adam [Kingma and Ba, 2014] with learning rate 1e-4 and batch size 512

batch_size.quote: using Adam [Kingma and Ba, 2014] with learning rate 1e-4 and batch size 512

target_update_rate.quote: The target is updated softly at every step with parameter τ = 0.005.

hyperparameter_selection.value: best of 6 values per dataset, selected by online evaluation; tuned on 3 seeds, then 7 more seeds
hyperparameter_selection.quote: We tune hyperparameters using 3 seeds, but then evaluate the best hyperparameter by training on an additional 7 seeds and then report results on the 10 total seeds.

evaluation_protocol.checkpoint_selection: final policy after fixed step budget (not otherwise stated); hyperparameter chosen by online evaluation
evaluation_protocol.quote: We report the mean and standard error over 10 seeds of the training process and using 100 evaluation episodes per seed.
